messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a canary deploy of release v2.3.0 today at 09:30 PT. Target: 10% canary for 30m, then ramp to 50% if smoke is clean. :rocket:
jon: I can own the canary smoke checks and monitor latency.
emma: I'll be on standby for rollback if anything weird pops up.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by maria for 1782507000 (09:30 PT). Target: canary=10%, duration=30m.
ryan: Can we confirm migrations are already applied in prod?
maria: yes — migrations ran yesterday during off-peak, no failures. migration-runbook link: https://internal/redwood/migrations/2026-03-16
olivia: Quick checklist I did: unit tests ✅, integration smoke ✅, model artifacts verified ✅.
lisa: Are feature flags set for gradual rollout? I can toggle if needed.
dan: I'll watch SLO dashboards and slow query traces. Will call out regression >5% tail latency.
emma: Signoff from security needed? any new scopes?
maria: No new scopes in this deploy. Security reviewed in PR.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook for rollback: https://internal/runbooks/deploy-rollback v2.3. Steps: a) toggle feature flag b) scale down canary pool c) revert model pointer d) notify users.
jon: Smoke commands I'll run after canary spins up:```bash
curl -sS https://canary.api.redwood/v1/health | jq .status
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .choices[0].text
```
qa-bot: Reminder: run the core prompt regression suite (suite id: core-smoke-2026) against canary.
ryan: I'll keep an eye on token cost per request for the canary to catch any token explosion.
maria: Need final approvals: @emma for rollback readiness, @jon for smoke owner, @lisa for flag control. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve.
emma: :thumbsup: ready for rollback.
jon: :thumbsup: I'll own smoke.
lisa: :thumbsup: I'll control flags.
deploy-bot: Approvals logged: rollback_ready=emma, smoke_owner=jon, flags_owner=lisa.
maria: OK scheduling in 10m. Post any last-minute blockers now.
olivia: no blockers from infra side. Autoscaling policies good.
dan: FYI I'll pre-warm tracing collectors 5m before deploy.
emma: If we need to rollback, I'll follow ops-runbook-bot steps and announce in this thread.
maria: Launching canary now (10%) — monitoring windows open.
deploy-bot: Canary started: v2.3.0 @ 10% at 1782507000.
jon: Smoke tests running... health=OK, sample generate returned expected prefix.
qa-bot: Core-smoke-2026: 28/30 tests passed, 2 flakey prompts flagged (non-regression).
dan: Latency p50 120ms, p95 +3% — within threshold.
ryan: token cost stable. No token anomalies.
olivia: infra metrics normal. No GPU OOMs.
maria: After 30m if no regressions we ramp to 50%. If any regression >3% on p95 or core-smoke failures >5 tests, we stop and rollback.
jon: continuing to monitor.
emma: Ready to execute rollback if threshold hit.
maria: Thanks everyone — will post update when ramp starts or if any issues. :white_check_mark:
